summary.text: HELGØ MENY DRIFT AS (998 006 503), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2012-01-09; address Breidablikkveien 3, 4017 STAVANGER, Norge. statements.text: Works in leasing of intellectual property and similar products, except copyrighted works (industry code 77.400).
